messages:
maya: Hey @it-ops — first day and my Okta MFA SMS never showed up. I used my UK number (+44 77X XXX XXXX). Also 1Password says I have no seat when I try the invite. Who should I ping?
it-ops: Welcome @maya! Quick checks: did you use your full company email (maya@redwood.com)? Check spam, carrier blocks, and short codes. We've seen O2 block some SMS shortcodes recently.
maya: Yep used maya@redwood.com. I checked spam and carrier SMS. No invite from 1Password either (invite@1password.com).
jordan: I can see an Okta enroll attempt but the provisioning job hung. DM me your employee ID and I'll re-run the job.
jordan: Reprovisioned now — you should get an Okta enrollment email. If not, try this orgless magic link (incognito): `https://okta.redwood.internal/enroll?token=REDACTED` (placeholder).
it-ops: If SMS still doesn't arrive, we'll switch you to WebAuthn/passkey or send a temporary YubiKey. Also check that your phone isn't set to block unknown senders.
okta-bot: Okta: enrollment email resent to maya@redwood.com (job id: 8772). Status: pending.
maya: I got the Okta email and started enroll but when it redirects to Google SSO it errors with "organization mismatch".
alex: That usually happens if you accidentally choose your personal Google account on the SSO screen. Try clearing cookies or use an incognito window and choose the corporate account.
maya: Incognito fixed the SSO redirect — thanks! Still one outstanding thing: 1Password web invite shows "No seats available" when I click the link.
it-ops: Are you a full-time headcount or contractor? Contractors need a manual temp seat request. If you're FT we'll escalate to people-ops.
maya: Full-time. @jordan @people-ops can you add me?
jordan: Looping in @people-ops to request a seat.
people-ops: Hi @maya — welcome! We approved a headcount seat for your role. @it-ops can you confirm and resend the 1Password invite?
it-ops: Seat added in 1Password for maya@redwood.com and invite resent.
1password-bot: 1Password: invite sent to maya@redwood.com (expires in 7 days).
maya: Got the 1Password invite and set it up. Okta MFA is now enrolled using passkey. All good — thanks everyone :tada:
